questions.stem_text: Which of the following causes the supply curve of paper to shift to the left?

options.A: Paper producers expect lower paper prices in the months ahead.
options.B: The price of pencils, a complement to paper, increases.
options.C: Improvements in the technology used to produce paper.
options.D: Environmental concerns reduce the yearly amount of timber that can be harvested.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Environmental concerns reduce the yearly amount of timber that can be harvested.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements is true?

options.A: The velocity of money is equal to real GDP divided by the money supply.
options.B: Dollars earned today have more purchasing power than dollars earned a year from today.
options.C: The supply of loanable funds consists of investors.
options.D: The demand for loanable funds consists of savers.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Dollars earned today have more purchasing power than dollars earned a year from today.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following insures the value of the U.S. dollar?

options.A: The euro and other foreign currencies held by the Federal Reserve
options.B: Gold bars in secure locations like Fort Knox
options.C: The promise of the U.S. government to maintain its value
options.D: The value of the actual paper on which it is printed.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The promise of the U.S. government to maintain its value
